NewsArticle.Title: Nightmare of Morrigu
NewsArticle.Content:
One of the fae priestesses rekindles the worship of Morrigu.
Feale Wizards and Priests with eighty insights: Discover the nightmare of the three sisters: Ana, Macha, and Madb. They choose who will die in battle by magic, bloodshed, and fury.
Dream of Morrigu, the dark faerie queen, and become Her avatar.
